svg.title: A robot wrapping around the room, and the four quadrants
svg.desc: Left: the example robot at 2,4 with velocity 2,-3 for five seconds, wrapping over the edges. Right: the room split into four quadrants; robots on the middle row or column are not counted.

g.text: each second every robot adds its velocity; after 100 s the robots are counted per quadrant
pos = mod(pos + vel, size) (mod keeps it ≥ 0)
middle row and column are skipped
part 1 = product of the 4 quadrant counts
